sentences.english: It is Monday morning.

sentences.text: Sam llega acá con una bolsa grande y una caja.
sentences.english: Sam arrives here with a big bag and a box.

sentences.text: Luis y Nico vienen con él para ayudar.
sentences.english: Luis and Nico come with him to help.

sentences.text: La casa de Karla está cerca de la clínica, en una calle pequeña.
sentences.english: Karla's house is near the clinic, in a small street.
Come, Sam!
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Come in, come in.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: This is your house now.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Thanks, Karla.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Where do I put the box?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Agarrá la caja con las dos manos, que pesa.
sentences.english: Take the box with both hands, because it weighs a lot.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Metela en el dormitorio y colocala al lado de la cama.
sentences.english: Put it in the bedroom and set it next to the bed.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Look, Sam!
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: I'm carrying your bag.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Thanks, Nico.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Pero no corrás, que la bolsa también pesa.
sentences.english: But don't run, because the bag is also heavy.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Nico, callate un momento y dejá pasar a Sam.
sentences.english: Nico, be quiet for a moment and let Sam pass.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.english: Stand here, beside me.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.english: I'll show you the house.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Esta es la sala, y ahí está el sofá.
sentences.english: This is the living room, and there is the sofa.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: It is old, but it is clean.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Over there is the dining room.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Ahí comemos todos, cuando estamos en casa.
sentences.english: We all eat there when we are at home.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: And my room?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Where do I go first?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Your bedroom is the last one.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Mirá, es pequeño, pero tiene una cama, una mesa y un armario.
sentences.english: Look, it is small, but it has a bed, a table and a wardrobe.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: It's very good.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: There is a blue curtain.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Yes.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Si hay mucho sol, movela un poco.
sentences.english: If there is a lot of sun, move it a bit.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: En el armario hay una almohada y una manta.
sentences.english: In the wardrobe there is a pillow and a blanket.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Very good.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Karla, ¿cuánto es el valor del cuarto?
sentences.english: Karla, how much is the rent for the room?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Ana didn't tell me.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: One thousand five hundred lempiras a month.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Podés pagar la mitad hoy y la otra mitad el día quince.
sentences.english: You can pay half today and the other half on the fifteenth.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: That's fine.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Thank you for renting me the room.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: You're welcome.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Para mí, esta casa no es solo una casa.
sentences.english: For me, this house is not just a house.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Es un hogar, y me gusta compartirlo.
sentences.english: It is a home, and I like to share it.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Ahora lo que más hay que saber.
sentences.english: Now what you most need to know.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Escuchá bien, porque lo digo una sola vez.
sentences.english: Listen well, because I'll say it only once.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Cuando salgás de tu cuarto, apagá la luz.
sentences.english: When you leave your room, turn off the light.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Cuando llegués de noche, encendé solo la luz del comedor.
sentences.english: When you come in at night, turn on only the dining-room light.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: El agua se mantiene siempre en la jarra grande.
sentences.english: The water is always kept in the big jug.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Llená la jarra cada noche, y cubrila.
sentences.english: Fill the jug every night, and cover it.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Protegé el agua, porque hay riesgo de enfermarse.
sentences.english: Protect the water, because there is a risk of getting sick.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: And the glasses?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: And the cups?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: And the bottles?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Guardá los vasos y las tazas al lado de la olla.
sentences.english: Put the glasses and the cups away next to the pot.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Evitá tomar agua de una botella que no conocés, de ningún tipo.
sentences.english: Avoid drinking water from a bottle you don't know, of any kind.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Take out only what you need.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Understood.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: And the rubbish?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: La basura va en una bolsa.
sentences.english: The rubbish goes in a bag.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: No la tirés en la calle.
sentences.english: Don't throw it in the street.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Sacala por la noche, y quitá la bolsa vieja cuando haya mucha basura.
sentences.english: Take it out at night, and remove the old bag when there is a lot of rubbish.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: And one more thing.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Con el uso, el piso necesita cuidado.
sentences.english: With use, the floor needs care.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Barré la sala y ordená tus cosas cada semana.
sentences.english: Sweep the living room and tidy your things every week.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: It is a form of safety.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: I'll do it.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Anything else?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Yes.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: If you need something, tell me.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: If you don't understand something, ask me.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Y no te olvidés de las llaves.
sentences.english: And don't forget the keys.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Mi problema con las llaves ya lo sabe todo el mundo, ¿verdad?
sentences.english: Everybody already knows about my problem with keys, don't they?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Everybody knows!
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: You'd better keep it yourself.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Later Nico wants to play.

sentences.text: Tiene una pelota en la mano y una sonrisa grande.
sentences.english: He has a ball in his hand and a big smile.
Let's play, Sam.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.text: Yo digo qué hacer, y vos lo hacés.
sentences.english: I say what to do, and you do it.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Shall we start?
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Yes, start.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Pick up the pillow.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Put it in the wardrobe.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Take it out again!
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Very good, Nico!
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Ya la tengo en la mano.
sentences.english: I already have it in my hand.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Put it on the sofa.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.text: Quitá la manta de la cama y tirala al piso.
sentences.english: Take the blanket off the bed and throw it on the floor.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Now move it to the dining room.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Stop.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Be quiet!
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Don't say anything.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Sam says nothing.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: You lost!
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: You talked.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Now go to the living room.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.text: Apagá la luz y encendela otra vez.
sentences.english: Turn off the light and turn it on again.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Done!
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Now you tell me what to do.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Fill the glass with water.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Tidy the shoes.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Sweep the floor.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.text: Andá a la cortina y movela.
sentences.english: Go to the curtain and move it.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.text: Nico, esto ya no es un juego.
sentences.english: Nico, this is not a game any more.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: It is work.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Karla entra en la sala y ve a Sam con la manta en una mano y la escoba en la otra.
sentences.english: Karla comes into the living room and sees Sam with the blanket in one hand and the broom in the other.
What are you doing?
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: ¿Un juego o el trabajo de la semana?
sentences.english: A game or the week's work?
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Both, Karla.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Sam obeys very well.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Then help me, Sam.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Sacá la almohada del sofá y colocala en tu habitación.
sentences.english: Take the pillow off the sofa and put it in your room.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Quitá la manta vieja y barré cerca de la mesa.
sentences.english: Take off the old blanket and sweep near the table.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Después andá al comedor y ordená las tazas.
sentences.english: Then go to the dining room and tidy the cups.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Llená la jarra, cubrila y movela al lado de la olla.
sentences.english: Fill the jug, cover it and move it next to the pot.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Hay una mezcla de arroz y frijoles en la olla, y es una buena parte de la comida de hoy.
sentences.english: There is a mixture of rice and beans in the pot, and it is a good part of today's meal.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Don't throw it away.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: I'll get to work.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: And the amount of water?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: How much do I have to fill?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Llená la jarra hasta la boca, pero con cuidado.
sentences.english: Fill the jug to the brim, but carefully.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: It weighs a lot.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Nico, pará de jugar y agarrá la escoba.
sentences.english: Nico, stop playing and take the broom.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Be quiet and help.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Then put it away in the wardrobe.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Sam, abrí la cortina de tu habitación y andá a tu dormitorio a ordenar las cosas.
sentences.english: Sam, open the curtain in your room and go to your bedroom to tidy your things.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Apagá el teléfono mientras trabajás, y encendé la luz del comedor.
sentences.english: Turn off your phone while you work, and turn on the dining-room light.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: And me?
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Where do I put the ball?
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.text: Metela en la caja, y dejá la caja en el sofá.
sentences.english: Put it in the box, and leave the box on the sofa.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Por la tarde, un amigo de Karla llega de otro país.
sentences.english: In the afternoon a friend of Karla's arrives from another country.
His name is Kevin.

sentences.text: Él habla de otra forma: dice «tú» y no «vos».
sentences.english: He speaks a different way: he says "tú" and not "vos".
Sam listens carefully.
Hello, Sam.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Come, look at this photo.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Tell me, who is this person?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: It's my sister.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Kevin, why do you say "ven" and not "vení"?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Porque en mi país hablamos con tú.
sentences.english: Because in my country we speak with tú.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Tú dices «ven», y tú dices «ven aquí».
sentences.english: You say "ven", and you say "ven aquí".
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: You all say "vení".
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Here we say "vos".
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Pero no te equivoqués: los dos están bien.
sentences.english: But don't make a mistake: both are fine.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: True.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: La diferencia no es un problema.
sentences.english: The difference is not a problem.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Solo es una forma diferente de hablar.
sentences.english: It is just a different way of speaking.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Entonces yo digo «vení» a Nico, y tú dices «ven» a tus amigos.
sentences.english: So I say "vení" to Nico, and you say "ven" to your friends.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: That's right.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Y a una señora que no conocés le decís «venga».
sentences.english: And to a lady you do not know you say "venga".
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Pero eso es para otro día.
sentences.english: But that is for another day.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Por la noche, el vecino, el señor Marvin, pasa por la casa. Trae unas palabras para Sam.
sentences.english: At night the neighbour, Mr. Marvin, comes by the house. He brings some words for Sam.
Sam, listen to me.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Cuando vivís en un pueblo nuevo, no busqués éxito.
sentences.english: When you live in a new village, don't look for success.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: En nuestra sociedad todos lo buscan.
sentences.english: In our society everyone looks for it.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Serví a la gente, y todo lo otro viene solo.
sentences.english: Serve the people, and everything else comes by itself.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Esta casa es un buen hogar, y es un buen comienzo.
sentences.english: This house is a good home, and it is a good start.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: How do I achieve that?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Salí cada día, mirá a las personas, preguntá cómo están.
sentences.english: Go out every day, look at people, ask how they are.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: Pray for them.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: No pierdas tiempo en cosas pequeñas.
sentences.english: Don't waste time on small things.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Hay una causa en cada problema, pero no siempre hay una solución.
sentences.english: There is a cause in every problem, but there is not always a solution.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: A veces solo hay amor, y el amor es lo que más ayuda.
sentences.english: Sometimes there is only love, and love is what helps most.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: Thank you, Mr. Marvin. What else?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Ask for forgiveness when you are wrong.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Perdoná cuando alguien te trate mal.
sentences.english: Forgive when someone treats you badly.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Esa es la libertad que da el evangelio.
sentences.english: That is the freedom the gospel gives.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: No pensés siempre en el futuro.
sentences.english: Don't always think about the future.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Vivir el presente con gracia es la mejor forma de tener felicidad.
sentences.english: Living the present with grace is the best way to have happiness.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Esa noche, Sam está en su habitación.
sentences.english: That night Sam is in his room.

sentences.text: Karla le habla desde la sala.
sentences.english: Karla speaks to him from the living room.

sentences.text: Sam, antes de dormir, hablá con Dios.
sentences.english: Sam, before sleeping, talk with God.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: En este hogar todos lo hacemos.
sentences.english: In this home we all do it.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Confess what you did wrong.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Pray for your family.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Make your request.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Thank him for the day.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Think of his mercy.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.text: Él convierte la tristeza en felicidad, y cuida tu alma mientras dormís.
sentences.english: He turns sadness into happiness, and takes care of your soul while you sleep.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: I will.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Hoy tengo mucho por qué dar gracias.
sentences.english: Today I have a lot to be thankful for.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Y mañana, no te quedés dormido.
sentences.english: And tomorrow, don't oversleep.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Sleep well, brother.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Good night, Karla.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Mi madre dice siempre: «Que Dios te cuide».
sentences.english: My mother always says: "May God take care of you."
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: And you too, Sam.
sentences.speaker: K

sentences.english: Good night.
sentences.speaker: K
